question: What mechanisms of action and therapeutic targets are being investigated in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis?

input.sql:
SELECT mt.moa_label, mt.provenance,
       count(DISTINCT mt.asset_id) AS n_assets,
       count(DISTINCT mt.nct_id) AS n_trials,
       max(mt.phase_rank) AS max_phase_rank,
       list(DISTINCT mt.asset_id) AS assets,
       list(DISTINCT mt.nct_id) AS ncts
FROM v_moa_trials mt
WHERE mt.condition_key = 'D054990'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY n_trials DESC
LIMIT 40

WITH scope AS (SELECT DISTINCT asset_id FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D054990')
SELECT coalesce(b.provenance,'none') AS tier, count(*) AS n_assets
FROM scope s LEFT JOIN v_moa_best b USING (asset_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT mt.moa_label, mt.provenance,
       count(DISTINCT mt.asset_id) AS n_assets,
       count(DISTINCT mt.nct_id) AS n_trials,
       max(mt.phase_rank) AS max_phase_rank,
       list(DISTINCT mt.asset_id) AS assets
FROM v_moa_trials mt
WHERE mt.condition_key = 'D054990'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY n_trials DESC
LIMIT 40 OFFSET 40

SELECT provenance, count(DISTINCT asset_id) AS n_assets, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS n_trials
FROM v_moa_trials WHERE condition_key='D054990'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, p.max_phase_ever, p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key='D054990' AND NOT a.is_combo
ORDER BY p.n_active_trials DESC, p.n_trials DESC
LIMIT 25
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset_id) FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key='D054990'

SELECT t.name AS target_symbol, count(DISTINCT m.asset_id) AS n_assets, count(DISTINCT mt.nct_id) AS n_trials
FROM v_moa m
JOIN unnest(m.targets) AS tt(target)
JOIN targets t ON t.target_id = tt.target
JOIN v_moa_trials mt ON mt.asset_id = m.asset_id AND mt.moa_key = m.moa_key
WHERE mt.condition_key = 'D054990'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY n_trials DESC
LIMIT 20;
